trial_court: Family Court, Khowai Tripura, case no. T.S (Divorce) 40 of 2021
case_name: Shri Bijan Ghosh vs Smt. Sanghamitra Debroy
facts_of_case: The appellant-husband filed an application for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia), (ib) and (iii) of the Hindu Marriage Act, which was dismissed by the trial court. The husband appealed against this decision.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the marriage has broken down irreparably.
legal_principles.held: Ms. S. Deb, learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the marriage between the appellant and the respondent has already been broken down irreparably as the respondent wilfully withdrew herself from the society of the appellant and is staying at her parental house since 2018 leaving behind her minor son and the appellant.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking maintenance must demonstrate a genuine need for support.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner shall continue to pay the amount of monthly maintenance to the respondent as per the concerned Order passed in connection with their Domestic Violence Case.

outcome.final_order: The minor son of the parties shall remain under the care and custody of the petitioner. The appellant-husband is entitled to get dissolution of marital tie between him and the respondent-wife by a decree of divorce.
